response.sql: WITH matched_scans AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.pressratio, si.riskeval FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), group_stats AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) as avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) as scan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_scans) as total_matched FROM matched_scans GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_pressratio, scan_count, CAST(scan_count AS FLOAT) / total_matched as share FROM group_stats ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
